scope: Supported local-only capacity for the unchanged original Omarchy qualification; this is a SessionStore setting, not a storage-format or workload change

retention.scope: Local desktop recording only; portable bundles remain capped by their existing independent policy

preflight.browserRule: quota - current usage >= the next bounded staging phase plus reserveBytes; recheck after the 8 GiB prefix and before each later 512 MiB batch because Chrome grows quota with committed usage
preflight.hostRule: filesystem available bytes at the Chrome profile/output location >= all new local payload plus all exported saved copies plus reserveBytes; this physical store proof has one new 16 GiB copy, while the later full cold run has both a fresh browser profile and a 16 GiB exported copy

unchanged.workload: original T01 amount and 50M transition checkpoint cadence
unchanged.archive: 4 GiB portable aggregate and individual blob policy
unchanged.budgets: all original T01 numeric performance limits
